name: Furthia Trails
summary: Meet Liam, the Doggaroo. After a cliffside tumble, he finds himself lost in the mysterious Goomshi Forest - a wild and dangerous place full of strange, alluring creatures with their own instincts.Help Liam survive, make unexpected alliances, tame creatures to assist in puzzles and exploration, and maybe… indulge in some carnal adventures along the way.
